rounds.plain: The check found a specialized queue-history and feeder-constraint dataset, with no second dated direct launch or other kill rule established at that stage.

K0: public utility data and AI scraping make the proposed dataset quick to copy. K3/K4: free public tools and existing products already serve the core need. K5: no payment evidence dated within 18 months was found.

risks: No verified revenue, paying customers or subscriber count.
Utility data redistribution terms are unverified.
Hosting-capacity maps must be presented as estimates, not guarantees.
New territory onboarding and source QA could exceed 5 h/week.
records.moat: Monthly queue history joined to feeder constraints could accumulate value, but the underlying data is public, competitors already cover the niche, exports reduce switching costs, and no months-hard-to-copy asset was found.

hours.note: Unverified estimate; onboarding a new territory and QA may exceed 5 h/week initially.

records.next_steps: Revisit only if a non-public data asset appears, such as compiled paid study reports or user-contributed data.

rounds.plain: K0: the moat score is under 4 and EAA Compliance already advertises legal mapping and an evidence ledger. K2: the record cites two competing launches in the window.
The check found no competing launch since 23 April 2026 and judged the evidence-ledger wedge distinct from lower-priced scanners and overlays.

risks: No verified revenue, customer count, MRR or churn evidence was found.
The EAA covers specified products and services, not every website; some service micro-enterprises are exempt.
Automated scans cannot establish full accessibility or legal compliance; human judgement is required.
The evidence-ledger and legal-mapping wedge is already advertised by EAA Compliance.
The 28 June 2025 application date is past, not a future commencement trigger.
records.moat: A maintained legal mapping and per-site scan history could create modest switching costs, but EAA Compliance already advertises a coverage matrix and append-only evidence ledger. The underlying rules are public, and no network effect was found.

hours.note: Target estimate conditional on self-serve onboarding and agent-run operations; legal-rule review and customer edge cases could push hours higher.

records.next_steps: Test one narrow eligible segment with a no-code page, sample dated evidence report, clearly labeled planned €29/month offer and voluntary waitlist. Share only where self-promotion is permitted or through an opt-in partner; the test would measure interest, not prove unique willingness to pay.
